name: rtx-pro-6000-2gpu-180gb
notes: 2-GPU RTX PRO 6000 (all 3 SKUs: WS / S / Max-Q), each 96 GB sm_120 Blackwell, for TP=2. The launcher runs one search per allowed_gpu_configs entry and unions the results, so all 3 SKUs are scanned. min_gpu_total_ram_mb=180000 (2x90GB) keeps only 96GB-class offers.
